generation_guards: Ensure exactly two dogs are visible and countable as two separate animals.
Ensure exactly one pig is visible.
Ensure exactly one cookie is visible.

initial_plan.generation_strategy: Compose a simple scene with four main subjects: two separate dogs, one pig, and one cookie. Arrange the cookie behind the pig so the front-of relation is clear, while keeping enough of the cookie visible to confirm it is present. Place the two dogs apart from the pig and each other so the dog count is unambiguous.
initial_plan.initial_prompt: A clear scene showing exactly two dogs, exactly one pig, and exactly one cookie. The single pig is positioned in front of the single cookie, closer to the viewer, with the cookie behind it but still clearly visible. The two dogs are separate from each other and not occluding the pig or cookie. All subjects are fully or mostly visible and easy to count: two dogs, one pig, one cookie. No additional dogs, pigs, or cookies.
